# Learning Objectives

::: {.callout-important icon="false"}
## At the end of the workshop, participants will be able to:

-   **Understand** the **Data Science pipeline.**

-   Gain **hands-on experience** with R, RStudio, the `{tidyverse}` and R Markdown to perform the Data scientist's tasks:

    -   Import, handle and visualize data

    -   Produce automated and reproducible reports with R Markdown files
:::

# AGENDA

## Thursday

```{r}
agenda_am <- tribble(
  ~Time, ~Topic,
  "08:30 - 09:00", "Renku set-up & Prework",
  "09:00 - 09:15", "Welcome",
  "09:15 - 10:00", "Introduction to R and R Markdown",
  "10:00 - 10:45", "Importing data with R + Exercises",
  "10:45 - 11:00", "Break",
  "11:00 - 11:15", "Exercises Walkthrough",
  "11:15 - 12:15", "Data wrangling (Part 1) + Exercises", 
  "12:15 - 12:30", "Exercises Walkthrough"
)

agenda_am %>% 
  kable()

```

## Friday 

```{r}
agenda_pm <- tribble(
  ~Time, ~Topic,
  "08:30 - 08:45", "Recap",
  "08:45 - 10:00", "Data wrangling (Part 2) + Exercises",
  "10:00 - 10:15", "Exercises Walkthrough",
  "10:15 - 10:30", "Break",
  "10:30 - 11:45", "Data visualisation + Exercises",
  "11:45 - 12:00", "Exercise 6: Walkthrough",
  "12:00 - 12:15", "Wrap-up",

)

agenda_pm %>%

```

## Duration

7 - 7.5 hours
